an3.7:1.1: Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo.
an3.7:1.3: Sāvajjena kāyakammena, sāvajjena vacīkammena, sāvajjena manokammena . . . pe . . . Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo. Katamehi tīhi? Anavajjena kāyakammena, anavajjena vacīkammena, anavajjena manokammena . . . pe . . . 8.
